answer_1.quote: While Large Language Models have significantly advanced the automation of code generation in popular programming languages such as Python or Java , the automation of HTML code generation from UI design remains under-explored and challenging.
answer_1.outputs: HTML code from UI design images

answer_2.quote: We adopt CLIP and Low-Level Element Matching (LLEM) metrics from previous work. Additionally, we introduce two new metrics: HTML-Match, designed to evaluate structural similarity in rendered HTML, and complex wavelet structural similarity index (CW-SSIM) to detect minor differences in images, respectively.

answer_4.quote: Two human annotators are asked to compare the rendered webpages generated by different techniques from a subset of test data with the ground-truth webpage and rank them.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters rank the generated webpages based on similarity to the ground-truth webpage without knowing which model produced each one.
